# Gaurav Chaudhary {.about-profile-name}

[↗ ANAMASGARD](https://github.com/ANAMASGARD){.about-profile-handle}

::: {.about-profile-intro}
I'm a Google Summer of Code 2026 contributor working on Animint2 with the R Project for Statistical Computing. My engineering work focuses on improving performance, renderer behavior, testing, and new features for interactive data visualizations.

This journal documents implementation progress, technical decisions, testing, learnings, and verified contributions throughout the project.
:::
